app.name: Rafiq
app.tagline: Your companion for understanding your reproductive health
meta.description: Rafiq is an awareness and guidance platform for male reproductive health, in Arabic and English, with no account and no identifying data. It is not a diagnostic tool.
noscript.message: Rafiq needs JavaScript enabled. In an emergency, call your local emergency number now.
nav.quick_exit_hint: Closes Rafiq immediately and takes you to another site. You can also press Esc twice.
demo.banner: Demo version — rules and content have not yet been approved by a medical professional. Do not use it to make health decisions.
welcome.title: Welcome to Rafiq
welcome.message: A safe, private space to understand your reproductive health and find your next step — without us asking your name.
welcome.auto_note: We'll take you to the home page in a moment.
landing.emergency_strip: Sudden, severe testicular pain? Don't wait — call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department now.
landing.hero.title: Understand your health, know your next step, and get ready for your doctor
landing.hero.subtitle: Rafiq is an awareness and guidance platform in Arabic and English. No account, no questions about who you are, and no diagnosis.
landing.what.title: What is Rafiq?
landing.what.body: Rafiq is a digital platform that helps men understand their reproductive health concerns, find reliable information, know when and where to seek care, and prepare to talk to a health professional. Rafiq does not diagnose, does not treat, and does not replace a doctor.
landing.offers.title: What does Rafiq offer?
landing.offers.learn.title: Reliable content
landing.offers.learn.body: Plain-language articles about male reproductive health, with their sources and review dates.
landing.offers.guidance.title: Guidance on your next step
landing.offers.guidance.body: Short questions that start with warning signs, then clear guidance: emergency care, a doctor today, an appointment, or information only.
landing.offers.prepare.title: Doctor visit preparation
landing.offers.prepare.body: An organised list of questions and what to bring, to print or save on your device.
landing.offers.ai.title: An AI that explains
landing.offers.ai.body: Rafiq AI simplifies terms and explains approved content when you ask.
landing.how.title: How does it work?
landing.how.step1.title: Choose your journey
landing.how.step1.body: Learning, a health concern, preparing for conception, or preparing for a doctor's appointment.
landing.how.step2.title: Answer or read
landing.how.step2.body: A few questions, most of which you can skip — or content to read with no questions at all.
landing.how.step3.title: Get your next step
landing.how.step3.body: Clear guidance and honest limits, which you can print or save on your device.
landing.privacy.title: How do we protect your privacy?
landing.privacy.point1: We never ask for your name, phone number, email or any identifying details, and you don't need an account.
landing.privacy.point2: Assessment answers are not stored on our servers; they are used to work out your guidance and then discarded.
landing.privacy.point3: We use no third-party analytics or advertising tools; we only count totals.
landing.privacy.point4: When you use the AI assistant, only your question — never your health answers — is sent to Google Gemini, which keeps it for a limited time to monitor for abuse.
landing.privacy.point5: You can clear everything or use Quick exit at any time.
landing.privacy.honesty: To be honest: no website is fully anonymous. Hosting servers may record technical data such as IP addresses for operations and security.
landing.ai.title: The role of AI
landing.ai.body: Rafiq AI is built on Google's Gemini and only works when you ask it to.
landing.ai.does1: Explains how to use the platform.
landing.ai.does3: Summarises and explains Rafiq's approved content.
landing.ai.doesnt1: It doesn't diagnose or assess your fertility.
landing.ai.doesnt2: It doesn't decide whether your situation is an emergency.
landing.ai.doesnt3: It doesn't prescribe medicines or treatments, and it never sees your health answers.
landing.limits.title: Rafiq's limits
landing.limits.can2: Help you identify a suitable general next step for your health.
landing.limits.can3: Help you organise questions for your doctor.
landing.limits.cannot2: Assess your fertility or give you a score or percentage.
landing.limits.cannot3: Confirm that your condition is normal.
landing.journeys.title: Choose your journey
landing.journeys.subtitle: You don't have to answer any questions to learn.
journey.learn.title: I want to learn
journey.learn.description: Browse reliable content about male reproductive health and ask Rafiq to explain it.
journey.concern.title: I have a health concern
journey.concern.description: We start with a few questions about warning signs, then help you find your next step.
journey.concern.gets: A priority level and your next step
journey.conception.title: I'm preparing for conception
journey.conception.description: Understand when a medical evaluation may be appropriate and how to prepare with your partner.
journey.conception.gets: Guidance and content to help you prepare
journey.doctor_prep.title: I want to prepare for a doctor's appointment
journey.doctor_prep.description: Organise your questions and what to bring into a list you can print or save on your device.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.a1: No. Rafiq offers awareness and general guidance about your next step; diagnosis only happens with a doctor.
landing.faq.q2: Do I need to create an account?
landing.faq.a2: No. You can use every journey without an account and without any identifying details.
landing.faq.a3: Every piece of content and every rule in Rafiq must be reviewed by a qualified medical professional before launch. In this demo version, medical approval is not yet complete.
landing.faq.q4: What should I do in an emergency?
landing.faq.a4: Don't use Rafiq. Call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department immediately.
footer.not_diagnosis: Rafiq is an awareness and guidance platform, not a diagnostic tool or a replacement for a doctor.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy
legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.limits.title: Platform limits
legal.sources.title: Sources
legal.draft_notice: This is a short version. The full version is being prepared and will be completed after legal review.
legal.privacy.intro: Rafiq is designed to work with as little data as possible. Here is what we do and don't do:
legal.terms.p1: Rafiq is a general awareness and guidance platform, and its information is for educational purposes only.
legal.terms.p2: Using Rafiq does not create a doctor–patient relationship and does not replace advice from a health professional.
legal.terms.p3: Rafiq is intended for adults (18 and over).
legal.terms.p4: In an emergency, call your local emergency number immediately and do not rely on Rafiq.
legal.sources.intro: Rafiq's content is written in our own words and checked against trusted health references, including:
legal.sources.not_approved: Listing these references does not mean Rafiq's content is endorsed by them or by a medical professional. Medical approval is not yet complete in this version.
safety.general: If you have sudden severe pain or think you need urgent care, call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department now.
errors.403.title: You can't access this page
errors.403.body: You don't have permission to view this page.
errors.404.title: Page not found
errors.404.body: The link may have changed or is no longer available.
errors.419.title: Session expired
errors.419.body: Your session expired to protect your privacy. Reload the page to continue.
errors.429.title: Too many requests
errors.429.body: You sent many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.500.title: Something went wrong
errors.500.body: We're working on it. Please try again shortly.
errors.503.title: Service temporarily unavailable
errors.503.body: We're doing maintenance or an update. Please try again later.
gate.age.title: Before you start
gate.age.question: Are you 18 or older?
gate.age.why: Rafiq is for adults. We don't ask for your date of birth, and we only remember your answer for this session.
gate.consent.title.conception: Before we start the conception questions
gate.consent.intro: You'll answer questions about your health. Here is what happens to your answers:
gate.consent.point1: We don't ask for your name or any identifying details.
gate.consent.point2: Your answers are only used to work out your guidance and are not stored on our servers.
gate.consent.point3: Your answers are not sent to the AI or to anyone else.
gate.consent.point4: You can skip most questions and stop at any time.
gate.consent.point5: The result is general guidance, not a diagnosis.
gate.consent.point6: If this is an emergency, don't continue — call emergency services now.
gate.consent.checkbox: I understand the above and agree to my answers being processed temporarily to work out my guidance.
gate.consent.decline: Not now — I'd rather just learn
under18.title: Rafiq is for adults
under18.body: Thank you for being honest. Rafiq is designed for people aged 18 and over, so we can't offer you the questions or the AI assistant.
under18.talk: If you're worried about your health, talk to a parent or another adult you trust, or to a doctor or school nurse.
ai_notice.title: Before you use the AI assistant
ai_notice.point1: The assistant gives general educational information, not medical advice.
ai_notice.point2: Your question and related approved content are sent to Google Gemini to generate the answer.
ai_notice.point3: Google keeps requests for a limited time (currently 55 days) to monitor for abuse. We don't store your conversation.
ai_notice.point4: Don't type your name, phone number or anything about your own health.
ai_notice.point5: If you have emergency symptoms, don't use the assistant — call emergency services.
clear.confirm_body: We'll end your session and clear your answers and choices from this browser, then take you back to the home page.
legal.privacy.controller_body: The organisation responsible for Rafiq and how to contact it will be published before public launch.
legal.privacy.process1: Assessment answers: sent in a single request to work out your guidance and then discarded — never stored in our database or logs.
legal.privacy.process2: Session preferences: language, age confirmation and consents, in an essential encrypted cookie that expires after 30 minutes of inactivity.
legal.privacy.process3: AI assistant questions: sent to Google Gemini after removing any personal details we detect; we don't store the text.
legal.privacy.process4: Aggregate statistics: daily totals only, such as home page visits, never linked to a visitor.
legal.privacy.process5: Technical logs at our hosting provider may include IP addresses for operations and security.
legal.privacy.never_body: Your name, phone number, email address, ID number, address, date of birth, precise location, photos or test results.
legal.privacy.cookies_body: We only use cookies that are essential to run the session and protect forms. We use no advertising or analytics cookies, so we don't show a cookie consent banner.
legal.privacy.retention_body: Answers: not stored. Session: 30 minutes of inactivity. AI usage data without message text: 90 days. At Google: under its policy (currently 55 days).
legal.privacy.rights_body: Because we keep no data that identifies you, we have no data linked to you to show, correct or delete. You can use "Clear everything" or "Quick exit" at any time.
legal.terms.p5: We may change these terms or stop some services, and we will update the last-updated date on this page.
